mapper.sql: o.order_id, o.user_id, o.total_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.order_status, o.pay_type, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.remark, o.pay_time, o.deliver_time, o.receive_time, o.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username, CASE o.order_status WHEN 0 THEN '待付款' WHEN 1 THEN '待发货' WHEN 2 THEN '待收货' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS status_desc FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
